env.name: GITHUB_APP_ID
env.description: App id of the fleet-runners GitHub App

env.name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key (PEM) of the fleet-runners GitHub App

env.name: WATCH_REPOS
env.description: Repositories this runner serves, comma-separated owner/repo; set by the orchestrator

env.name: MAX_JOBS
env.description: Jobs run at the same time

env.name: RUNNER_NAME
env.description: Server name, prefix of every runner name

env.name: RUNNER_LABELS
env.description: Labels a job must ask for, besides self-hosted, linux, x64

env.name: JOB_ENV
env.description: JSON of variables given to jobs, per repository or "*" (preview credentials, Console CI token)
